title: String Functions — Normalize Emails
description: Use UPPER, LTRIM, RTRIM, and REPLACE to normalize email addresses.

data.text: Write a query to normalize email addresses: trim whitespace, convert to lowercase, and replace spaces with underscores.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    Email AS OriginalEmail,
    LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(Email, ' ', '_')))) AS NormalizedEmail
FROM Customers
ORDER BY CustomerID;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: String functions in SQL Server: UPPER/LOWER convert case; LTRIM/RTRIM remove leading/trailing spaces; REPLACE substitutes characters. LEN() returns string length, SUBSTRING() extracts substrings. These can be nested — inner functions execute first.
